# GSAP

`gsap.min.js` is the distribution (trailing whitespace normalized) from `gsap@3.15.0`, pinned in the npm lockfile. Its upstream copyright and license notice are preserved in the file header. See the [GSAP standard license](https://gsap.com/standard-license/) and [source](https://github.com/greensock/GSAP).

Only the company homepage loads the library. It is served locally; production has no CDN or package-manager dependency. To refresh after deliberately updating the pinned package, copy `node_modules/gsap/dist/gsap.min.js` here.
